text: Power meter device - SICAM P50/55 | Siemens
Why SICAM P50/55 power meter device?
SICAM P50/55 is a power meter for electrical systems. Acquire and display over 100 measured values to monitor energy consumption and power quality across your grid networks.
heading: Why SICAM P50/55 power meter device?

text: Struggling with stable power supply or optimizing energy use? Our SICAM P50/55 power meter continuously logs energy data to provide operational insights. Identify consumption sources and peak times to lower energy costs and prevent power quality fluctuations.
heading: Why SICAM P50/55 power meter device?

text: Measure over 100 electrical values, including harmonics, for power quality analysis. Integrate with existing systems using PROFIBUS-DP, MODBUS RTU/ASCII or IEC 60870-5-103 protocols. Rely on the graphic display and 1 MB memory for data recording and monitoring so you can preserve data during outages.
heading: Why SICAM P50/55 power meter device?

text: Identify energy consumption sources and peak usage times in your electrical systems. Gain insights to allocate and reduce energy costs.
heading: Lower energy usage

text: Prevent power quality fluctuations and grid disturbances. Optimize monitoring, control and automation systems for stable electric power during energy transitions.
heading: Maintain power stability

text: Process and analyze data from grid components and get valuable insights on your grid's state for advanced analysis. Improve asset performance and extend service life with informed decisions.
heading: Optimize with data

text: Measure over 100 electrical values: RMS voltages, currents, active and reactive power, energy, power factor and harmonics up to the 21st. Get external signals and states for comprehensive analysis of your power supply systems.
heading: 100+ electrical value measurement

text: Connect using PROFIBUS-DP, MODBUS RTU/ASCII or IEC 60870-5-103 protocols for communication with your infrastructure. Parameterize via front key or RS485 port with SICAM P Manager software.
heading: Communication protocol integration

text: Record measured values and states with precise time stamps. Use 1 MB of programmable non-volatile memory. Store limit value violations and energy counter values safely for up to three months during power outages.
heading: Data storage and records
